answer: Make every reward a garden, not a prize. Earnings keep their weight only while the identity tends what it planted: answering follow-ups, correcting errors, updating old work as the network's voyage moves on. Neglect lets a plot go fallow, and like a willow left unwatered its weight wilts a little each week. A sybil farmer holding fifty plots cannot tend them all, because sustained attention cannot be cloned — flooding starves, while one well-tended garden compounds.
